messages.subject: Katerina | Industrial & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Katerina,

Your executive-search work across Industrial / Production and Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where operating performance depends on government relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and country-facing execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition and complex multi-stakeholder operating environments.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in industrial, energy, infrastructure and natural-resources sectors. I am internationally mobile and open to Europe, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
